segments.text: 。团队把它记录为已知局限，并让消息文字保持简短，这样即使它
arrived at an awkward moment
segments.sentence: The team documented it as a known limitation and kept the message text short so it would be easy to understand even if it arrived at an awkward moment.

segments.text: 也容易理解。

paragraphs.original: The delay is a pragmatic choice, not a guarantee. The team documented it as a known limitation and kept the message text short so it would be easy to understand even if it arrived at an awkward moment.

segments.text: ## 团队接受的取舍

paragraphs.original: ## Trade-offs the team accepted

segments.text: 每个无障碍修复都有代价。播报搜索状态可能有帮助，但
too many announcements become noise
segments.sentence: Announcing search status can be helpful, but too many announcements become noise.

segments.text: 。团队选择播报开始和最终数量，而不是每个中间状态。这意味着在极慢连接下的用户可能一段时间内等待而没有更新。可见的状态行
partly covers that gap
segments.sentence: The visible status line partly covers that gap, but it is not a full solution.

segments.text: ，但它不是完整的解决方案。

paragraphs.original: Every accessibility fix has a cost. Announcing search status can be helpful, but too many announcements become noise. The team chose to announce the start and the final count, not each intermediate state. This means a user on a very slow connection may wait without updates for a while. The visible status line partly covers that gap, but it is not a full solution.

segments.text: 把焦点留在输入框支持继续打字，但这意味着键盘用户必须
take an extra step
segments.sentence: Keeping focus in the input supports continued typing, but it means a keyboard user must take an extra step to reach results.

segments.text: 才能到达结果。团队加了一个“Skip to results”链接，在搜索完成后出现。这带来了
a small amount of visual clutter
segments.sentence: This adds a small amount of visual clutter, which they judged acceptable.
segments.currentForm: a small amount of visual clutter

segments.text: ，他们认为可以接受。

paragraphs.original: Keeping focus in the input supports continued typing, but it means a keyboard user must take an extra step to reach results. The team added a "Skip to results" link that appears after a search completes. This adds a small amount of visual clutter, which they judged acceptable.

segments.text: 他们还决定不
auto-focus the first result
segments.meaning: 自动聚焦到第一条结果
segments.sentence: They also decided not to auto-focus the first result.

segments.text: 。自动聚焦可能让用户意外，并把他们从正在做的事情上移开。相反，他们让用户自己选择何时移动。这对一些人来说更慢，但对其他人来说
more predictable for others
segments.meaning: 对其他人来说更可预期
segments.sentence: This is slower for some people but more predictable for others.

paragraphs.original: They also decided not to auto-focus the first result. Auto-focus can surprise users and move them away from what they were doing. Instead, they let the user choose when to move. This is slower for some people but more predictable for others.

segments.text: 最后，团队把搜索结果放在一个带有清晰标题的列表里。他们
resisted the urge to
segments.sentence: They resisted the urge to make the interface more dynamic with animations and expanding cards.

segments.text: 用动画和展开卡片让界面更花哨。每增加一种行为，都需要它自己的
accessible explanation
segments.meaning: 无障碍说明（让各类用户都能理解的解释）
segments.sentence: Each added behaviour would need its own accessible explanation, and the team did not have the capacity to test that carefully.

segments.text: ，而团队
did not have the capacity to
segments.sentence: Each added behaviour would need its own accessible explanation, and the team did not have the capacity to test that carefully.
segments.currentForm: did not have the capacity to

segments.text: 仔细测试这些行为。

paragraphs.original: Finally, the team kept the search results in a list with clear headings. They resisted the urge to make the interface more dynamic with animations and expanding cards. Each added behaviour would need its own accessible explanation, and the team did not have the capacity to test that carefully.

segments.text: ## 他们会给另一个团队的建议

paragraphs.original: ## What they would tell another team

segments.text: Northwind 团队最终交付的界面并不完美。他们交付的是一个
communicates more honestly
segments.sentence: They finished with one that communicates more honestly and that they can keep improving.

segments.text: 、并且能持续改进的界面。他们给其他团队的建议是：
start with the moments of change
segments.meaning: 从发生变化的关键时刻入手
segments.sentence: Their advice to another team would be to start with the moments of change, not the visual design.
segments.currentForm: start with the moments of change

segments.text: ，而不是从视觉设计入手。要问一问：搜索开始、结束和失败时，用户需要知道什么？然后再决定如何传递这些信息，同时
without interrupting the person who is typing
segments.sentence: Then decide how to deliver those messages without interrupting the person who is typing.
segments.currentForm: without interrupting the person who is typing

paragraphs.original: The Northwind team did not finish with a perfect interface. They finished with one that communicates more honestly and that they can keep improving. Their advice to another team would be to start with the moments of change, not the visual design. Ask what a user needs to know when a search begins, when it ends, and when it fails. Then decide how to deliver those messages without interrupting the person who is typing.

segments.text: 要用不同工具的人来测试，哪怕只是非正式地测。一次简短的测试就能
reveal assumptions that no checklist will catch
segments.meaning: 暴露出任何清单都发现不了的假设
segments.sentence: A short session can reveal assumptions that no checklist will catch.
segments.currentForm: reveal assumptions that no checklist will catch

segments.text: 。把你接受的局限写下来，因为
accessibility work involves trade-offs
segments.sentence: Write down the limitations you accept, because accessibility work involves trade-offs, and future maintainers need to understand why the interface behaves as it does.

segments.text: ，而未来的维护者需要理解界面为何这样表现。信息要短，
keep focus predictable
segments.sentence: Keep messages short, keep focus predictable, and make status visible to everyone.

segments.text: ，并且
make status visible to everyone
segments.meaning: 让所有人都能看到状态
segments.sentence: Keep messages short, keep focus predictable, and make status visible to everyone.

segments.text: 。这些步骤都不光鲜，但合在一起，它们能
turn a silent update into a conversation the user can follow
segments.meaning: 把无声的更新变成用户能跟得上的对话
segments.sentence: None of these steps is glamorous, but together they turn a silent update into a conversation the user can follow.
segments.currentForm: turn a silent update into a conversation the user can follow

paragraphs.original: Test with people who use different tools, even informally. A short session can reveal assumptions that no checklist will catch. Write down the limitations you accept, because accessibility work involves trade-offs, and future maintainers need to understand why the interface behaves as it does. Keep messages short, keep focus predictable, and make status visible to everyone. None of these steps is glamorous, but together they turn a silent update into a conversation the user can follow.
